section_summary.extract_value: This section reports a single sample of 253 Portuguese women from the general population aged 18–50 (M=25.00, SD=7.15). Mean BMI was 21.76 kg/m2 (SD=3.26) with 10.67% underweight, 74.70% normal weight, and 14.63% overweight. The text does not mention assessment instruments for body appreciation or whether BMI was measured versus self-reported, nor does it reference multiple studies or label this as 'Study 1'.
section_summary.evidence_source: A total of 253 Portuguese women from the general population, aged between 18 and 50 years old (M=25.00; SD=7.15) were enrolled in the study. Participants' body mass index mean was 21.76 kg/m2 (SD=3.26), which corresponds to normal weight values. Twenty-seven participants (10.67%) were underweight (BMI<18.5), 189 (74.70%) presented a normal weight (18.5≥BMI≤25.0), and 37 (14.63%) were overweight (BMI>25), which refects the BMI distribution in the female Portuguese population [33].
